decision.description: The next decision the reader would make, in one sentence.

decision_line.description: First 1-based line at which the decision became makeable; -1 if never.

words_above_fold.description: Words on lines 1..decision_line, or in the whole file when decision_line is -1.

known_to_reader.description: Sentences that restate what the reader already knows, or narrate the author's process.

missing.description: Facts the decision needed and did not get.

cut_list.description: Lines whose removal would not change the decision.
